Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Jeff Dai <jd...@gpu5.srv.ualberta.ca> wrote:
>Can a Giovanni or Ravnos become a Camarilla Exmplary or Archon? Can
>These clans even vote on these?

Non-Camarilla vampires cannot become Archons or Exemplary. However,
they may cast votes on the outcome, just as they can in any political
action. Remember that votes represent the vampire's ability to influence
those with power, not just the vampire's power.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
